study.question: Under the frozen inputs, history policy and training recipe, do explicit historical action codes improve full-population validation click AUC beyond aligned item content and the supplied task masks in g3-r0058-fixed_angle_negative?
study.hypothesis: The imported incumbent improves click AUC from baseline-din 0.6555440824200336 to 0.6689610675617089 but provides no matched action-utility ablation. Its action vectors enter the activation scorer, pooled values and five history summaries, while task masks independently expose feedback membership. Holding that whole algorithm fixed, full action distinctions may improve click prediction beyond a retrained shared-token representation. Concordant losses from blindness and retrained action permutation would support conditional utility; a loss under evaluation-only permutation alone could be distribution disruption. This is a prospective ablation study with no novel-architecture or established-mechanism claim.

nearest_work.difference: The strongest visible local model is inherited exactly as the unchanged utility control. Treatments are inserted immediately before item/action embedding; its architecture, task loss and custom gradient mechanism are not new contributions. No unavailable parent trajectory is imported as evidence.

inherited_components: All modules, allocated embeddings, initialization, task towers, auxiliary heads, target-match/position/block/quadratic/duplicate summaries and input features from g3-r0058-fixed_angle_negative.
Action-aware local activation; original user/context and target item channels; uniform click pooling, auxiliary feedback routing and the four supplied task masks.
Folded Dice training support, independent auxiliary running buffers, fully pruned evaluation and unchanged state/parameter registration.
Four true-label BCE terms and the exact inherited FP64 fixed-angle/reversed auxiliary context surrogate VJP; it remains a surrogate, not the ordinary BCE derivative.
Frozen host data, official_offline history visibility, scoring, optimizer, precision, batch policy and resource accounting.
study.proposed_difference: Three standalone copies add only a metadata/parameter-free action-input treatment immediately after get_inputs has returned unchanged historical/task masks and before the embedding lookup. candidate.py replaces valid codes by one schema-chosen existing nonspecial learned token; action_permuted.py rotates valid codes within each row in both phases; action_eval_permuted.py does the same only during eval. action_full.py is the exact accepted ancestor, byte-identical. Non-action dictionary entries, invalid/padding action bytes, all positions and the zero target action are retained. No data, loader, scorer or host recipe changes. No cross-example action exchange, new labels or new sources.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: full_action_replay minus action_blind_constant click AUC. Hypothesized positive; use 0.0002 AUC as a prospective practical resolution, not a post-hoc significance threshold. Report the raw paired difference regardless of sign, all four task AUC/Logloss values, and auxiliary mean separately.

Secondary alignment contrast: full_action_replay minus action_permuted_retrained. A positive difference plus a blind loss is concordant but not sufficient for a broad action-utility mechanism claim. Rotation preserves per-example action composition.

Diagnostic: compare full_action_replay with action_permuted_eval_only, and the latter with action_permuted_retrained. Recovery after retraining suggests an input-disruption/optimization explanation for some evaluation-only loss.

At fixed weights in eval, blind predictions must be invariant to changes of valid action codes with masks/item fields fixed. Permutation preserves action multisets exactly, is identity on empty/singleton/constant-code histories, and is invariant to changes of invalid action bytes after inherited masking. Target action remains zero. Empty-history predictions for treated versus untreated input at the SAME checkpoint must match; independently trained empty-history predictions need not match.

Host preflight before fitting must check full and eval-only train-mode forward/backward and state parity, constant-token invariance, noncontiguous masks, target/padding identity, no host input mutation and output shapes/finite loss. Modules, initialization and allocated counts must agree in every arm. Inspect surrogate validity/norm summaries if supported; any failures are retained and interpretation suspended.

Validation slices are predeclared: history length0,1-16,17-64,65-100; code diversity0,1,>=2 distinct valid codes; task-mask auxiliary membership absent/present. Record rows/tokens actually changed by rotation and sample/positive/negative counts, marking insufficient slices. Other hour/frequency/unseen-field slices are exploratory and only use host-authorized metadata with training-defined bins.

Record actual parameters, active action-row usage where host permits, training/allocated GPU seconds, total wall time, examples, peak memory, inference throughput and batch p50/p95 latency. Input transformation overhead is included; parameter equality does not imply equal cost. Fixed-recipe comparison isolates this implemented intervention; no efficiency win without measured cost.

For repeated support, target three paired host seeds for full, blind and retrained permutation when a subsequent authorized schedule permits; never override the frozen seed in variant config. Report paired user-cluster bootstrap intervals where host has authorized user grouping, otherwise label uncertainty unavailable. One-seed results remain preliminary. Repeated initializations measure robustness, not independent mechanisms.
falsifiers: If the retrained blind arm equals or exceeds full action, a useful incremental contribution is unsupported at that run resolution; repeated paired results whose differences stay below the predeclared0.0002 practical resolution falsify a consequential benefit for this recipe. A single null neither proves equivalence nor universally refutes action modeling.

If a paired uncertainty interval lies wholly within +/-0.0002, treat the primary contrast as practically equivalent at the predeclared resolution; if wide or crossing both directions, the answer remains unresolved.

An evaluation-only permutation loss without a concordant blind loss is insufficient for conditional utility; if retraining removes that loss, input disruption is the more direct supported interpretation.

Any input/mask/position/target mutation, altered architecture or initialization, a failed full/eval-only training replay, unmatched data exposure or changed objective invalidates the corresponding attribution. Coverage failures such as all-constant codes make permutation nulls uninformative.
alternative_explanations: One frozen seed is preliminary; correlated user exposures and ordinary optimizer variation can dominate small differences.

Supplied task masks can retain feedback information, possibly enough to reconstruct codes. This tests usefulness of the explicit code channel conditional on those masks, not total feedback utility or conditional mutual information.

The inherited nonstandard surrogate VJP is held fixed as an algorithm; changing action values can change its data-dependent gradients and validity gates. Report gate/norm diagnostics where available; do not claim gradient trajectories remain identical.

Allocated representation capacity and data exposure are matched, but useful code-dependent function capacity and action-row update frequencies cannot remain identical after information removal. Report this rather than asserting active-capacity equality.

Different normalization populations and optimizer trajectories induced by code replacement can mediate an effect. Holding the normalization and surrogate algorithms fixed does not make their realized statistics fixed.
Action masks can render explicit codes redundant. A negative code-channel result is compatible with substantial total historical-feedback utility.

Existing click gain over DIN trades off auxiliary quality: incumbent cart/fav/buy AUC0.8103901/0.8255792/0.8029242 versus DIN0.8490697/0.8648975/0.8701823. No aggregate multi-task improvement is implied.

Only two authorized successful trajectories are visible. There are no scoped action-related memory hits and no accessible local failed/abandoned branches to review; ancestor IDs mentioned in receipts are not additional local evidence.

Official offline delayed feedback, released whole-window filtering/vocabularies and publisher snapshots limit point-in-time production interpretation. Auxiliary labels match user/category/brand within24h, not ad-specific conversion.
